jobs.title: Global Process Owner - R2R
jobs.reason: This is a senior global finance process ownership role (Record-to-Report / Procure-to-Pay), entirely outside the candidate's field of international relations and law. It requires deep finance process expertise, ERP systems knowledge, and ideally ACCA/CIMA qualification, none of which the candidate holds, and the seniority level (owning $1.6B turnover processes, influencing 180 finance staff) is far beyond entry level.

jobs.title: Future Lead Auditor for ISO 13485
jobs.reason: This is a medical-device auditor role requiring a BSc in biomedical/life sciences and four years of medical device industry experience — entirely outside the candidate's IR/policy field and skill set. Pure mismatch on field and specialist technical skills.

jobs.title: Working Student - Data & Polling (m/f/d)
jobs.reason: ECFR is a leading European foreign policy think tank — a direct fit with the candidate's core interests in IR and European policy. The data/polling focus aligns well with their quantitative skills (SPSS, Python, Excel), and the working-student format is exactly appropriate for their MSc-in-progress stage.

jobs.title: Assistant Accountant
jobs.reason: Hard ineligibility triggered: the role requires part-qualification in AAT, CIMA, ACCA or equivalent accounting credentials, which the candidate does not hold. The position is also a pure finance/accounting role unrelated to the candidate's IR/policy field.

jobs.title: Campaigning, Senior Consultant
jobs.reason: This is a senior corporate communications/campaigning role requiring 6–9 years of experience, which is a hard ineligibility trigger for the candidate. The field (corporate PR for FTSE/Fortune clients) is also far from the candidate's IR/international law focus.

jobs.title: Associate Lecturer in Archaeology
jobs.reason: Hard ineligibility: the role requires a completed or near-completed PhD in Roman archaeology, which the candidate does not have. Field (Roman archaeology) and skills (subject-matter expertise, undergraduate teaching experience) are entirely outside the candidate's IR/international law profile.
